model: Atlas Copco XAS 88 · 7 bar / 5.0 m³/min
required_spec: Request pressure-specific FAD with actual ambient derating and installed treatment. Nominal motor demand 3.888 m³/min; planning target 4.471 m³/min including 15% allowance.
purpose: Preferred listed compressor for flow margin. XAS 78 is the smaller candidate; XAS 68 is below continuous demand.
open_items: The 7 bar source leaves only 0.7 bar above 6.3 bar at the motor. More FAD does not cure a pressure shortfall. No price, availability or rental date confirmed.

model: Matched aftercooler + separator + automatic drain; Atlas TD if separate
required_spec: Deliver motor inlet ≤40°C at the chosen ambient and 3.888 m³/min or higher. At 35°C ambient this needs ≤5 K approach or extra cooling.
purpose: Compression heat must be removed before expansion.
open_items: An aftercooler alone does not provide +3°C pressure dew point. Quote drains and connections as a complete package.

model: Atlas Copco FD / FD+ / FD VSD refrigerated dryer
required_spec: +3°C pressure dew point at ≥4.471 m³/min corrected capacity, actual inlet/ambient temperature and operating pressure.
purpose: Establishes the dry-air boundary used in the source study.
open_items: No exact FD size or electrical suffix selected. Require the correction table and total installed pressure loss, not just nameplate flow.

model: Atlas Copco DD(+) + PD(+) coalescing filter housings and drains
required_spec: Both stages sized for ≥4.471 m³/min at operating pressure; matched to dryer sequence.
purpose: Removes compressor oil aerosol and bulk contamination upstream of the lube-free motors.
open_items: Include dirty-element pressure drop in the total treatment budget. No airline oil lubricator is specified.

model: Atlas Copco QD+ / QDT carbon stage + required dust post-filter
required_spec: Dry-air oil-vapour stage sized at full flow; supplier to specify filter sequence, consumables and achieved air quality.
purpose: Coalescers and oil-vapour removal serve different roles.
open_items: Motor exhaust cleanliness must also be checked; lubrication-free does not certify the final delivered air.

model: Commercial compressed-air hose assembly · 38 mm clear ID
required_spec: 38 mm clear ID main hose, working-pressure rating ≥10 bar and above actual source maximum, temperature rating covering inlet service. Factory-assembled compatible couplings.
purpose: Limits supply pressure loss while keeping the compressor away from the release area.
open_items: Quote actual clear bore, coupling losses and hose material. Length changes are screened below. Small quick couplers can dominate pressure loss.

model: Stock isolation / dump set, normally closed pulse valve, 4-way distribution manifold
required_spec: Full-flow main path ≥3.888 m³/min at actual pressure; 24 VDC control; commanded spray ≤10 s. Document flow curve, minimum differential pressure and response time.
purpose: Controls and distributes the warm compressed air before the motors.
open_items: Supplier selects valve code, seals, manifold ports and stop circuit. Include valve loss in warm pressure budget. Valve startup and motor acceleration are outside saved CFD.

model: Industrial pressure regulators + gauges + 19 mm ID branch hoses
required_spec: 6.3 bar gauge at each running motor; 16.2 L/s free air each; branch hose starts at 2 m × 19 mm clear ID.
purpose: Measures and balances each motor inlet under load.
open_items: Regulator flow curve must show pressure droop at the actual inlet/output differential. Motor port threads and fitting reducers need the manufacturer drawing.

model: Atlas Copco LZB46-RL-A025-11 · SKU 8411047249
required_spec: Nominal 840 W each at 1270 rpm, 6.3 bar gauge, with the 16.2 L/s catalogue free-air point.
purpose: Current four-motor expansion hypothesis. Nominal total 77.6 g/s uses the document’s free-air density conversion.
open_items: Not a guaranteed refrigeration product. Confirm exhaust thermal state, backpressure response, exact port dimensions and declared flow reference state.

model: Magtrol HD-810-5C load stations with controller, brake supply and blower
required_spec: Each holds about 6.3 N·m at 1270 rpm and absorbs 840 W. Request 240 V / 50 Hz blower version, speed control and calibrated torque/speed logging.
purpose: Extracts the shaft work assumed by the cooling calculation. Place rejected heat outside the cold stream and target.
open_items: HD-810 ratings: 14 N·m / 12000 rpm / 3000 W continuous with vendor duty limits. Quote the full station, not a bare brake. This is research equipment, not a cost-optimised demo load.

model: Stock motor feet / dynamometer fixtures, keyed couplings and guards
required_spec: Motor foot reference 4430 0575 80; coupling and fixture matched to both shaft drawings and allowable shaft loads.
purpose: Connects each motor to its external load.
open_items: Exact coupling bore, key, alignment and mounting arrangement remain unspecified. No custom turbine or custom shaft load is proposed.

model: Stock full-flow motor exhaust adapters / transitions
required_spec: Short exhaust neck; expand promptly to ≥50 mm clear ID cold branch. Quote complete port-to-hose path and its loss.
purpose: A small exhaust neck can consume the low-pressure delivery budget before the large nozzle.
open_items: The recommended 16 mm hose size is not a measured motor port bore. The 100 mm printed nozzle inlet is not a motor connection. Get exact exhaust drawing and a supported adapter.

model: Commercial low-temperature flexible cold-air hose · 50 mm clear ID
required_spec: Low-temperature material rated to at least −10°C for this nominal study; supplier confirms minimum actual exhaust temperature. Use oversized low-loss bends.
purpose: Carries each motor exhaust to one outlet with limited residence time.
open_items: This is near-atmospheric service. Confirm pressure loss, wall heat gain and suitable air-contact material. Do not substitute a long 16 mm hose.

model: Stock 50-to-100 mm transitions, 100 mm cuffs and clamps
required_spec: Match the 50 mm ID hose to the printed 100 mm OD nozzle spigot. Source nozzle clear inlet is 95.2 mm.
purpose: Completes the cold hose-to-nozzle interface.
open_items: Supplier confirms real inner/outer diameters, seal engagement and low-loss transition. Print the hose fit coupon before the nozzle set. No attached fit is verified.

model: Closed-cell cold-pipe insulation · 19 mm starting thickness
required_spec: Vapour-sealed insulation around cold branches and transitions; supplier selects material and low-temperature rating. Screening conductivity 0.035 W/(m·K) is assumed.
purpose: Reduces cold-path warming and external condensation.
open_items: Thermal result below covers only the hose shell. It excludes motor conduction, connectors, solar load and startup cooldown.

model: 280 × 40 mm wide slot · 100 mm spigot · opposed banks
required_spec: Use the matched STL/STEP and fit coupon. Total flow 77 g/s in selected CFD; nominal motor calculation is 77.6 g/s.
purpose: Starting nozzle configuration supported by the selected external CFD screen.
open_items: Nozzle interior, stock fitting, manifold balance and actual 0.96°C boundary are unvalidated. Smaller flows need diversion or a separately characterised motor point.

model: 24 VDC supply + timer/PLC + valve interface + stop + trigger input
required_spec: Hard maximum 10 s valve-on, manual test input, presence input and loss-of-control shutdown. Interface to selected valve and motor load controls.
purpose: Controls the experiment and later pass-by activation.
open_items: Keep existing trigger electronics if suitable. Exact PLC, power supply and presence-sensor codes are not selected; avoid buying replacements before interface definition.

model: Alicat MQ-series mass-flow meter · 5000 standard L/min candidate
required_spec: Dry air, pressure rating above actual source maximum; MQ family maximum 320 PSIA. Declare standard reference state and installed pressure loss.
purpose: Checks total flow; inlet flow represents motor exhaust mass only after leak and bypass accounting.
open_items: Final MQ gas/range/connection code to quote. Specify g/s output or reference-state conversion. Branch balance needs sequential tests or four smaller meters. Full range does not guarantee accuracy at the 2 g/s endpoint.

model: NI-9213 + cDAQ-9171 + 8 exposed-junction thermocouples
required_spec: Fast fine-wire Type T or K probes covering −20…60°C; cold-junction compensation, logging software and target ≥10 samples/s on used channels.
purpose: Measures inlet, exhaust, delivered air and ambient. Move a calibrated probe grid across the same 5 × 5 cm patches.
open_items: Confirm scan mode, probe response, total calibrated uncertainty and computer compatibility. Air probes need radiation/conduction error checks.

model: Testo 512-1 · 0563 1512 differential pressure meter
required_spec: 0–200 hPa range; connect exhaust pressure to atmospheric reference. Add static taps and suitable sample tubing.
purpose: Measures exhaust path loss against the document’s provisional 1–2 kPa screening flag.
open_items: The flag is not a vendor-approved motor limit. Use separate ≥0–10 bar instruments for compressed supply; never apply main pressure to this low-pressure meter.

model: Calibrated low-speed air-velocity probe and pressure-dewpoint check
required_spec: Velocity coverage approximately 0.1–10 m/s; dewpoint measurement at operating pressure to confirm +3°C PDP.
purpose: Validates jet reach and source drying rather than temperature alone.
open_items: Exact instrument/probe codes need availability and uncertainty review. Standard room-humidity probes do not verify pressure dewpoint.

model: Stock extrusion stands / clamps, electrical distribution and condensate handling
required_spec: Match CFD opposed nozzle banks 1.1 m apart, outlets at 1.15 and 1.55 m. Provide independently supported hoses. Utilities sized from full vendor load schedule.
purpose: Holds the actual configuration and supports the compressor/dryer/load rig.
open_items: Dryer plus four brake blowers/controllers need external electricity. Confirm 230/240 V, 50 Hz, starting current and connector ratings. No total electrical demand or installation price is verified.

model: Stock warm-side receiver, isolation, drain, gauge and relief package
required_spec: Pressure rating above actual source maximum. Size using usable pressure swing and measured compressor response.
purpose: Bridges short warm-supply transients; not needed for steady flow if the full supply budget passes.
open_items: At 7→6.7 bar gauge, a small tank stores little usable free air. It is not a ten-second standalone supply. No pressurised cold buffer is specified.
